scope: Post-primary descriptive review of the already selected most recurrent null edge; no new test, threshold, model fit or scientific comparison
probability_role: Descriptive probability under random matching with fixed binary detection margins; not replacing the frozen count test

native_code_review.HBE_covariance: The implementation estimates the covariance of same-row centered random Fourier-feature products (res.T @ res / n). Sparse missing joint detections could affect this estimate; this is a mechanistic hypothesis, not a separately tested causal explanation.
native_code_review.permutation_branch: The native branch uses p = 1 - sum(observed_stat >= permutation_stats)/B, a strict upper tail with no plus-one correction. A future discrete-count permutation implementation needs explicit tie handling; no such change was made.
